ALCHEMIST-AURIC_SEAL.description: The first card you draw each turn is [gold]Infused[/gold], or gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Antitoxin[/gold] if it cannot be.
ALCHEMIST-AURIC_SEAL.flavor: It has opinions about which page matters.
ALCHEMIST-AURIC_SEAL.title: Auric Seal
ALCHEMIST-EVERFLOWING_CHALICE.descriptio: At the start of each combat, choose a [gold]Mix[/gold] to add into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
ALCHEMIST-EVERFLOWING_CHALICE.flavor: However much you pour, it never quite runs dry.
ALCHEMIST-EVERFLOWING_CHALICE.title: Everflowing Chalice
ALCHEMIST-GILDED_KIT.description: You can [gold]Brew[/gold] at Rest Sites and gain [blue]1[/blue] extra potion slot.
ALCHEMIST-GILDED_KIT.flavor: An ornate case. The gold is not for show.
ALCHEMIST-GILDED_KIT.title: Gilded Kit
ALCHEMIST-GLOWING_SHARD.description: Whenever you gain [gold]Poison[/gold], apply [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold] to a random enemy.
ALCHEMIST-GLOWING_SHARD.flavor: The glow outlasts everyone who admires it.
ALCHEMIST-GLOWING_SHARD.title: Glowing Shard
ALCHEMIST-MIDAS_FRUIT.description: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Unripe Fruit[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
ALCHEMIST-MIDAS_FRUIT.flavor: Midas chose poorly, but he planted well.
ALCHEMIST-MIDAS_FRUIT.title: Midas Fruit
ALCHEMIST-SECOND_SKIN.flavor: What gets through the first one still has this to argue with.
ALCHEMIST-SECOND_SKIN.title: Second Skin
ALCHEMIST-SNAKE_TAIL.description: The first time your [gold]Antitoxin[/gold] reaches [blue]0[/blue] each combat, gain [blue]8[/blue] [gold]Antitoxin[/gold].
ALCHEMIST-SNAKE_TAIL.flavor: No serpent has ever died of its own bite.
ALCHEMIST-SNAKE_TAIL.title: Snake Tail
ALCHEMIST-SPARE_DOSE.flavor: A measured dose, always within reach.
ALCHEMIST-SPARE_DOSE.title: Spare Dose
ALCHEMIST-WEATHERED_KIT.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold] and [blue]8[/blue] [gold]Antitoxin[/gold]. You can [gold]Brew[/gold] at Rest Sites.
ALCHEMIST-WEATHERED_KIT.flavor: A well worn and pleasantly smelling case.
ALCHEMIST-WEATHERED_KIT.title: Weathered Kit
